subject: Discovery: Paybridge integration & inference needs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@paybridge.com>, Priya Shah <priya@paybridge.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery: Paybridge integration & inference needs

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps: 

- Current pain: inconsistent latency on your real-time fraud checks and high token cost for high-volume batch scoring.
- What we heard: need <100ms 99th pct latency for the scoring path, want predictable unit costs, and tight audit logs for compliance.
- Immediate proposal: run a 2-week pilot on Dedicated capacity using our quantized candidate model + prefix caching to validate latency and cost.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll loop in our SE to scope the integration and confirm SLOs (schedule 45m).
2) We’ll share a pilot plan + estimated committed capacity and pricing.
3) You confirm internal resources and preferred start date (we suggested mid-July).

Attachments: initial mapping worksheet (paybridge-mapping.xlsx) — feel free to fill the ‘sample traffic’ tab before the SE call.

Availability: I’m free next Tue/Wed 10–12 PT for the technical scoping. Does that work?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

----
On Mon, Jun 29, 2026 at 11:00 AM Alex Johnson <alex@paybridge.com> wrote:
> Thanks for the deep dive today — Priya and I will review with infra and get back with dates.
> 
> Alex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Jul 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Discovery: Paybridge integration & inference needs — internal alignment before re-contact

Quick internal note — Alex hasn't responded with a firm date yet (they said they'd check infra). Before I send a polite bump, want to align on:

- Dev: do you want to run through the mapping sheet and call checklist so we have a clear ask (sample traffic, expected qps, auth flow)?
- Sean: curious if you want me to offer a short pilot credit or a light SLA summary to move them? (We have some flexibility for mid-market motion.)
- Mateo: FYI for CS (if pilot runs) — any onboarding constraints we should call out now?

Plan A: send a one-line bump to Alex on 7/07, offering 2 window options for the SE call.
Plan B: wait until 7/12 and include a short pilot summary + SLA doc if we still don't have dates.

Thoughts?

Thanks —
Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@paybridge.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@paybridge.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Jul 2026 10:16:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery: Paybridge integration & inference needs — quick check-in

Hi Alex —

Just checking in — did you have a chance to confirm availability for a short technical scoping call with our SE? We can do either:

- Tuesday 7/13, 10:00–10:45 PT
- Wednesday 7/14, 11:00–11:45 PT

If those don't work, tell me a time that does and we'll accommodate. Also attaching the mapping worksheet again.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachment: paybridge-mapping.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Prep for Paybridge re-contact — demo plan & ask list

Team —

If we re-open this next week, here’s the suggested SE runbook and materials to have ready:

- SE goal: validate end-to-end latency on 1–2 representative requests, confirm auth path, and outline caching strategy.
- Deliverables: short demo + runbook, estimated Dedicated config (GPU type/slots), pilot success criteria, and a one-page SLA summary.
- Docs attached: paybridge-map-deck.pdf (demo flow), redwood-sla-summary.pdf.

Dev: can you review the mapping deck and confirm the expected qps numbers we should test?
Mateo: once pilot is scoped, I’ll need your onboarding checklist and estimated days-to-live.
Sean: if we want to give a pilot credit, propose the amount and I’ll offer it in the re-engagement note.

I plan to send the more substantial re-engage message (pilot + SLA) if no response by Tues 7/13.

Cheers,
Marissa
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Internal: Prep for Paybridge re-contact — demo plan & ask list

Marissa — quick notes after reviewing the deck:

- Sample traffic: recommend testing with 500 rps bursts, steady-state 150 rps. I added those to the mapping sheet.
- Auth: looks like OAuth2 bearer; we'll need a short session to validate header passthrough.
- Demo env: I can stand up a small Dedicated config for the test (4x A10G equiv) and run latency profiles.

I can join the SE call on 7/14 at 11:00 PT. Mateo — can you confirm onboarding lead?

Thanks,
Dev
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex@paybridge.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@paybridge.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery: Paybridge integration & inference needs — pilot & pilot dates

Hi Alex —

Following up with a concrete option so it's easy to choose next steps. We haven't heard back, so wanted to offer a short pilot framework if you're still interested:

Pilot summary (2 weeks) — what we propose:
- Dedicated test cluster configured for your sample traffic (we suggest 4x A10G equiv for the initial pass).
- Quantized model candidate + prefix/KV caching to validate 99th pct latency under representative load.
- Onboarding + runbook from our CS lead (Mateo).
- Optional: $5k pilot credit toward committed capacity for the pilot if you sign up for a 3‑month reserved block.

Proposed slots for technical scoping (SE + Dev on the call):
- Wed 7/14, 11:00–11:45 PT (Dev confirmed availability)
- Thu 7/15, 10:00–10:45 PT

If either works, I’ll send a calendar invite and the demo deck. If now isn’t the right time, a quick reply with timing (Q3 / later) helps us prioritize.

Thanks — hope to connect,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-sla-summary.pdf
